tool_args.rationale: The damped-fast-transient signature and long forecast horizon leave competing transient and equilibrium mechanisms indistinguishable from the five correlated pilot rows. A fine trajectory can resolve their time dependence.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary equilibrium or single-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations have coupled inputs and nearly identical long horizons, so they do not identify the transient mechanism or its dependence on state.
It is not a relevant discriminating measurement.
